subject.title: Memory dreaming run pegs the gateway event loop for ~10 min until killed; short-term recall store can never persist (2026.6.9, reproduces on unmodified dist)

question: Should the memory-core owner first run a live profiling investigation with the reporter’s samples and corpus shape before selecting the scheduling and persistence repair?
rationale: The report supports urgent investigation, but the safe fix depends on identifying whether the monopolizing segment is promotion, serialization, file-close microtasks, or gateway session scheduling.

options.title: Profile before repair
options.body: Collect the supplied evidence and reproduce the long-run path before choosing a bounded-execution and persistence design.

options.title: Prioritize interruption observability
options.body: Land only the separate interrupted-run observability work first, accepting that the RPC starvation remains unresolved.
